Jules (AE): Prospect requires BYOK via their AWS CloudHSM (FIPS 140-2 L3). They want: a short POC checklist, sample key policy, procurement bullets for costs (is there a recurring per-CMK line?), and timeline for Private+HSM.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll write a minimal POC to prove encrypt/decrypt, alias rotation, and a controlled revoke to show fallback. Keep it demo-friendly.
Simone (Security): Security asks: forward CloudTrail KMS events to their log account; key policy must Deny ScheduleKeyDeletion except via SOW; prefer aws:SourceVpc condition. Confirm whether they require split-knowledge ceremonies for on-prem HSM.
Kai (SRE): If they insist no key material leaves their account, Hosted is out. Options: Redwood Private in their VPC or on-prem HSM. We'll need: VPC peering/Transit GW details, assumable IAM role ARN (or KMS grant), and maintenance window for rotation tests.
Jules (AE): Procurement: do HSM-backed CMKs add a Redwood monthly fee or just customer CloudHSM billing?
Kai (SRE): CloudHSM in their account is billed to them by AWS. Redwood will propose: one-time integration SOW + recurring Private ops fee when we host the control plane. Hosted managed keys have no per-CMK pass-through. I'll stub numbers in the SOW ticket.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): POC runbook (concise):
1) Customer creates HSM-backed CMK in their AWS account and tags it redwood-poc.
2) Add Key Policy or KMS Grant to allow our service role: kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey.
3) Share CMK ARN + assumable role/grant to Redwood.
4) Run encrypt/decrypt via Redwood API; capture p95/p99 of KMS calls.
5) Rotation test: alias swap (transparent) and a rewrap scenario (new key + re-encrypt sample objects) depending on customer choice.
6) Revoke grant to simulate failure and show labeled non-HSM fallback for demo only.
Simone (Security): Sample key policy snippet to hand infra (replace ARNs/account IDs):
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"123456789012"}}},{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"*"},"Action":["kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion"],"Resource":"*"}]}
Simone (Security): Also require CloudTrail forwarding, alerts on repeated kms:Decrypt failures, and 90-day retention by default. Escrow: Redwood does NOT hold customer CMK material for BYOK unless contractually required and SOWed with ceremony controls.
Jules (AE): Timeline: prospect wants kickoff in ~3 weeks. Can we commit?
Kai (SRE): If they provide IAM role, peering, and security contacts quickly: POC environment in ~7-10 business days. Private+CloudHSM integration ~4-6 weeks. On-prem HSM adds procurement lead time.
ticket-bot: Created ticket INF-9988 for "HSM integration cost stub & POC pack".
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Action: I'll produce one-page POC + test payloads by EOD tomorrow.
Simone (Security): I'll prepare questionnaire answers and flag anything needing legal review.
Jules (AE): I'll consolidate and send the kickoff invite once the pack is ready. Thanks team :thumbsup:
